title: No module named 'frappe.utils.modules' Possible source of error: crm (app)

posts.name: Tom Ssemwogerere
posts.cooked:

posts.name: Muqeet Mughal
posts.cooked:
You just need to replace

 from frappe.utils import get_modules_from_all_apps_for_user

with

 from frappe.config import get_modules_from_all_apps_for_user

in
frappe-bench/apps/crm/crm/api/init.py
